purpose: Development-only selection of an ACI-inspired past-only early-departure guard. Candidate learning rates are compared on May only; this file must never be used as final evidence.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At plug-in use April calibration plus only actual unplug outcomes already observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: Compare only learning rates 0.005, 0.01, and 0.02 on May. Select coverage at or above 90% first, then P10 service, Jain index, and energy service. Validate the selected value unchanged on June.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Operational past-only adaptive guard; no finite-sample, per-driver, or conditional guarantee.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations.

solar_data.note: Solar-resource proxy, not measured rooftop PV.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Synthetic shared-import scarcity, not Caltech's measured feeder limit.
